hooks.command: sh -c '[ -z "$PR_REVIEW_CHILD" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); case "$p" in *"gh pr create"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; url=$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r ".tool_response | tostring" | grep -oE "https://github[.]com/[^/ ]+/[^/ ]+/pull/[0-9]+" | head -1); [ -n "$url" ] || exit 0; cd "$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r .cwd)" || exit 0; f="$HOME/.cache/pr-review/$(printf "%s" "$url" | cut -d/ -f4-7 | tr / -).md"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; (PR_REVIEW_CHILD=1 claude -p --setting-sources user --permission-mode auto "/code-review xhigh $url" >"$f" 2>&1; osascript -e "display notification \"Findings saved to $f\" with title \"Review finished\"") </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &'
